stem.en: A human sperm carries 23 chromosomes. What must happen before a new human life can begin?

text.en: It must grow by itself into a small body.

feedback.en: A human sperm cannot grow into a person alone.

text.en: It must double its own number back to 46.

feedback.en: The number comes back when two gametes join, not by doubling alone.

text.en: It must first divide again by meiosis.

feedback.en: Meiosis has already made the gamete. Another division would not help.

text.en: It must join an egg, which also has 23.

explanation.en: A human gamete cannot grow into a person alone. A sperm and an egg must join, and together they bring back the full set of 46.

hints.en: Where could the other 23 chromosomes come from?
